description: This file is a PHP source code that generates a web interface for configuring WAN network settings on a router or gateway device. It includes server-side logic to get device information, control flow for different user roles, and client-side JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and AJAX calls to update configurations.

methods.name: changeAutoWanMode
methods.description: Handles the user's request to change the WAN mode, confirms via a dialog, and triggers configuration save.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to save the selected WAN network configuration and reloads the page upon success.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Performs AJAX request to update the WAN network mode configuration.
